annotations.title: Find a NYC doctor for a work injury

description: Searches The Comp Desk's directory of medical providers in New York City's five boroughs (public CMS NPI Registry listings) by borough or ZIP code, specialty, language and whether they accept new patients. The directory is NOT the Board's authorization list: each result says to confirm the provider is WCB-authorized before booking.
name: find_providers
